dedupe_keys.name: nepal total municipal budget and solid waste management budget in 58 municipalities fiscal years 2010 to 2012

description: This table gives, for each of 58 municipalities in Nepal, the total municipal budget and the part spent on solid waste management in the fiscal years 2010 to 2012. The figures were extracted by OpenNepal from the Asian Development Bank report Solid Waste Management in Nepal: Current Status and Policy Recommendations and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange in 2014. The single CSV file is free to download under the Open Database License (ODbL), which requires attribution and share-alike for derived databases. Coverage is the 58 municipalities that existed at the time of the study, before Nepal's 2017 local government restructuring. Caveats: OpenNepal is now inactive, the download link points to its old server and may fail, HDX gives no methodology, and the numbers are budgets, not actual expenditure. Simulation uses: spending levels and the share of municipal budgets going to waste services, to calibrate cost and financing assumptions in waste service models for Nepal and similar countries. Related records: household waste composition from the same Asian Development Bank study (data-nepal-household-waste-composition-58-municipalities) covers the same municipalities.
